---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for HEXPal
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Speed-First Consideration
**Important:** HEXPal follows a speed-first design philosophy. Every feature must justify its impact on speed.

- [ ] This feature makes getting HEX codes faster
- [ ] This feature simplifies the workflow
- [ ] This feature doesn't slow down the core workflow
- [ ] This feature is essential for the core use case

**How does this feature impact the < 2 second workflow target?**

## Use Case
Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be useful.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Feature Category
- [ ] Core functionality (MVP)
- [ ] Developer workflow enhancement (V1.1)
- [ ] Advanced feature (V2.0)
- [ ] AI-enhanced feature (V2.1+)
- [ ] Other

## Performance Impact
- [ ] No performance impact expected
- [ ] Minimal performance impact (< 50ms)
- [ ] Moderate performance impact (50-200ms)
- [ ] Significant performance impact (> 200ms) - **Requires strong justification**
